verdict.rationale: An API spec is a fair question for a cloud agent product, so the axis applies. However, probes found no OpenAPI or equivalent: all candidate spec paths returned 404, and the runtime probe found no dots-specific public API surface. The llms.txt index and markdown doc mirrors are documentation access only, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
